user.actor: ZCodeGraph maintainers evaluating retrieval candidates before product integration
user.job: Decide whether candidate C reduces audited recovery Read/Grep fallback relative to the current plan() baseline in interactive Claude Code sessions, without changing any product-default gate.

baseline.workflow: Frozen offline retrieval evaluation (C passed G-entry) -> independent interactive paired agent evaluation (method selected here) -> possible, separately gated G-ship substantiation. Existing scripts/agent-eval/itrun.sh drives the interactive TUI; parse-arms.mjs counts raw Read/Grep but does not yet classify audited fallback.
failureModes: Single agent runs conflate retrieval effects with stochastic trajectories.
Repeated runs of one task are dependent observations and must not inflate the independent sample size.
Raw Read/Grep counts mix recovery, legitimate deepening, edit preparation, and verification.
Headless execution and an unimplemented C runtime switch cannot represent the intended interactive, single-variable comparison.
The v3 holdout has already informed candidate selection and cannot be an independent acceptance set.
baseline.costToday: Interactive tmux + Claude Code + MCP runs and manual fallback annotation are expensive; final N and repetitions must be calibrated by a pilot rather than convenience.

targetOutcome: A reproducible protocol that estimates C's within-task reduction in audited recovery Read/Grep, with task-clustered uncertainty, correctness guardrails, independent tasks, and explicit continue/revise/stop rules.
goals: Choose between native benchmark adoption, borrowing methodological components, and a repository-specific paired ablation.
Predeclare the primary estimand, arms, pairing and order randomization, inference unit, and missing-run policy.
Define contamination controls, a rank-destruction control, and correctness guardrails without claiming more causal identification than they provide.
Use pilot variance and a practically important effect to determine the final sample size and budget.
nonGoals: Re-evaluate the frozen v3 offline Hit@5/MRR results.
Make final code-patch correctness the primary endpoint for this retrieval-value slice.
Build a general-purpose agent benchmark or prove that retrieval always helps agents.
Approve C for product defaults or change G-entry/G-ship thresholds.
Claim that a shuffled-rank control alone identifies the complete causal mediation from retrieval to agent behavior.

constraints.statement: Reuse interactive Claude Code TUI via tmux and ZCodeGraph MCP; headless print-mode is not a substitute. A default-OFF runtime arm switch must preserve the same tool schema and prompts.
Reuse baseline-agent-sufficiency-v1: recovery reads differ from legitimate deepening, edit preparation, and verification. Raw parser counts are not yet the audited primary endpoint.
The v3 holdout is permanently frozen. Use a separately annotated task set with declared provenance, timing, and independent review; do not promise zero training contamination without evidence.
Task is the independent cluster; repeated trials and repositories are not independent task replicates. Preserve task-level pairing and disclose missing runs and order.
Single maintainer plus agent; annotation and interactive execution dominate cost. Usefulness-validation only, with no production HA or dashboard scope.

assumptions: Candidate C can later be exposed through a runtime opt-in switch without changing tool schema; this is not implemented yet.
Five to eight pilot tasks with four trials per arm are for variance and harness calibration only, never for confirmatory significance.
An MDE of 1.5 fewer recovery Read/Grep calls per task is a proposed practical threshold pending maintainer approval, not an observed effect.

The final protocol may revise ADR-0013's bootstrap interval requirement to task-clustered intervals plus paired randomization inference; that revision requires a separate accepted ADR before confirmatory execution.
No absolute task count or budget is justified until pilot variance and missingness are measured.
decisionScope: One reusable unit capability: the evaluation methodology and harness contract for retrieval-value Agent A/B, not the whole ZCodeGraph product.

options.name: Adopt SWE-bench, tau-bench, AgentBench, ToolBench, or T-Eval unchanged
Borrow repeated-trial consistency, fixed-variable execution, ablation, and significance methods
Build repository-specific ZRA-Paired v1 from those components
